items.text: Starting a skill training centre works when you pick a skill with local job demand, hire trainers who can do the work, check approvals and affiliations first and make only claims you can prove, because a centre depends on the trust of students and local employers.
Confirm demand with local employers, then add courses and centres as results come in.
Registration, affiliation, tax and consumer rules differ by state and course type.
